2027.description: The 2027 governor races in Kentucky, Louisiana and Mississippi. No forecast numbers until the governors model is frozen.
2027.lede: Kentucky, Louisiana and Mississippi elect governors in fall 2027, the year between the midterms and the presidential election.
2027.note: Nothing here is a forecast yet. The governors model is being designed and tested on past races; its numbers appear only after its design is frozen. These races are its first live run.
